children: may fall to $5,299 per metric ton, as suggested by a channel technique and a projection analysis.
The lower channel, which was duplicated from the upper channel, points at the target of $5,299, the 138.2% projection level of a wave c.
Resistance is at $5,467, a break above which may lead to a gain into the $5,526-$5,635 range.
* The cocoa report is published every Wednesday and Friday.
